## Xml Api

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/xml-api/grant-api/overview): There are two parties involved in any grant: - **Grantor** : The Braintree merchant that owns the embedded experience and is sharing access to a payment method in their Vault.
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/xml-api/grant-api/overview/java/): There are two parties involved in any grant: - **Grantor** : The Braintree merchant that owns the embedded experience and is sharing access to a payment method in their Vault.

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/xml-api/grant-api/overview/python/): There are two parties involved in any grant: - **Grantor** : The Braintree merchant that owns the embedded experience and is sharing access to a payment method in their Vault.
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/xml-api/grant-api/overview/ruby/): There are two parties involved in any grant: - **Grantor** : The Braintree merchant that owns the embedded experience and is sharing access to a payment method in their Vault.
- [Configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/xml-api/grant-api/configuration): The recipient can [search](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/xml-api/grant-api/search#recipient)for any transactions they've created using granted payment…
- [Revocation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/xml-api/grant-api/revocation/ruby): When the grantor deletes a payment method from their Vault, they can simultaneously revoke all grants of that payment method to other merchants.
